# Numeric Motion

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Animate the same count with numericText(countsDown:), reversing direction as the value crosses a digit boundary and then decreases again.

- Before: Digits change instantly
- After: Digits animate in direction

APIs: `numericText(countsDown:)`, `contentTransition`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present NumbersDoExample() in your app.
struct NumbersDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0
    @State private var countsDown = false
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            NumbersDoContent(phase: phase, countsDown: countsDown)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Decrease") { countsDown = true; phase -= 1 }
            Button("Increase") { countsDown = false; phase += 1 }
            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; countsDown = false; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct NumbersDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .largeTitle
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    var countsDown = false

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        Text(129 + phase, format: .number)
            .font(font)
            .monospacedDigit()
            .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .numericText(countsDown: countsDown))
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .default, value: phase)
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
